summary: Steep Stanley Terrace kerb with cars parked; homes 14-15 m behind.

best_section.where: South kerb of Stanley Terrace, near the eastern end, fronting the tree hedge

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 15 m (at 4 m) and 14 m (at 21 m) behind the kerb, screened by a dense hedge and trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking lane with cars parked on it, room to pull fully off the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way street, cars parked on both sides.
drivers.convention: Cars park on this kerb, so a van fits in. 2P limit applies, with resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm.

flags: Steep: about 8.5% grade here, 9.8% mean over the stretch, max 13.2%
2P parking signs, resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-7pm
sun_shade: Hedge and trees on the south side give shade; the road is open to the north.
